name: Kim Keheley Frye
tagline: Top rated Criminal Defense attorney in Marietta, Georgia
education: Georgia State University College of Law
about: With experience conducting more than 50 jury trials, Kim Keheley Frye founded the Frye Law Group, LLC, and represents those in Cobb County and the Atlanta metropolitan area who have been charged with a crime, including drug offenses, sex offense and DUI. A former assistant district attorney who prosecuted cases in superior and juvenile court, Ms. Frye is a passionate defender of the rights of every citizen.

As a lifelong resident of Cobb County, Ms. Frye was honored to receive a degree in criminal justice from the University of Georgia before earning a Juris Doctor from the Georgia State University School of Law. During her time in law school, she completed internships at the Southern Center for Human Rights and the Fulton County Solicitor’s Office and was given a Governor’s Honor internship in the Blue Ridge Judicial Circuit.

Kim Keheley Frye is a graduate and faulty member of the Gerry Spence Trial Lawyer's College completing the graduate course and Defense of the Damned. After passing a additional rigorous examination, Ms. Frye is now designated as a Lawyer-Scientist by the American Chemical Society-CHAL. With experience on both sides of the aisle, Ms. Frye is a passionate advocate for those facing criminal charges and is admitted to practice before the Georgia Court of Appeals, the United States Supreme Court, the Supreme Court of Georgia and the Superior Courts of Georgia.

She is a member of the Cobb County Bar Association, the Georgia Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers, the DUI Defense Lawyers Association, the State Bar of Georgia and a life member of the National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers.
